description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves TRANSHUMAN STRATEGIST (WP-S2): at the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active: round 2, P1 Space Wolves take the first turn, WARLORD = Logan Grimnar (Transhuman Strategist), 6 CP each. (1) Loading the save starts battle round 2: P1 gains 1CP (Command phase) + 1CP (Transhuman Strategist) = 8, P2 (Orks) 7; the scoreboard reads CP:8 and the Game Log names Transhuman Strategist. (2) Setup privilege: jump to the END of the Orks' turn (Scoring phase, active player 2). (3) A real click on the phase button ends the Orks' turn: battle round 3 begins with the Space Wolves Command phase and the rule fires again — P1 10 CP, P2 8 CP; nothing is recorded against GameState's 10e bonus-CP cap.
